headline: Bangladesh Parliament condemns attack on actress Badhon in Venice
summary: Lawmakers call the assault on the actress 'unforgivable' after she was targeted in Italy for her support of the 2024 uprising.
details: The National Parliament of Bangladesh expressed strong condemnation on Tuesday following an attack on popular actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon in Venice, Italy.
Reserved seat MP Johurat Adib Chowdhury raised the issue, describing Badhon as a 'July warrior' who stood by the general public during the 2024 uprising.
MP Chowdhury alleged that 'identified' individuals linked to the former fascist regime targeted the actress in Italy because of her political stance.
Deputy Speaker Kaisar Kamal described the assault as an 'unforgivable and condemnable crime' and a 'crime against humanity,' calling it an extreme expression of cruelty.
The Parliament sought updates from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding the measures being taken to ensure justice and protect Bangladeshi citizens abroad.

Meanwhile, the Milan Consulate has pledged all possible assistance to the actress, and reports suggest some individuals linked to the Venice Awami League have been identified in connection with the incident.
caption:
An 'unforgivable crime against humanity' — Bangladesh's Parliament reacts to the attack on actress Badhon in Venice.

The National Parliament of Bangladesh expressed strong condemnation on Tuesday following an attack on popular actress Ajmeri Haque Badhon in Venice, Italy.

Reserved seat MP Johurat Adib Chowdhury raised the issue, describing Badhon as a 'July warrior' who stood by the general public during the 2024 uprising.

MP Chowdhury alleged that 'identified' individuals linked to the former fascist regime targeted the actress in Italy because of her political stance.

Deputy Speaker Kaisar Kamal described the assault as an 'unforgivable and condemnable crime' and a 'crime against humanity,' calling it an extreme expression of cruelty.

The Parliament sought updates from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs regarding the measures being taken to ensure justice and protect Bangladeshi citizens abroad.

Meanwhile, the Milan Consulate has pledged all possible assistance to the actress, and reports suggest some individuals linked to the Venice Awami League have been identified in connection with the incident.

#Bangladesh #Badhon #Venice #Justice #HumanRights #News

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, The Daily Star
